architecture: Use live connectors/system APIs for current operational data where possible instead of duplicating mutable person-level spreadsheets.
Use GitHub for safe schemas, field definitions, version history, aggregate compliance workbooks and workflow rules.
Use restricted local stores for completed employee/applicant/payroll/medical/discipline records.
Generated reports need system-signature classifiers, not template fingerprints alone.
When a legacy tracker duplicates authoritative system data, preserve historical schema but avoid perpetuating duplicate manual entry.
